name: 44858-sharedprefix-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, draft_tensor_parallel_size 1.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params; EAGLE3 draft head of 1 decoder layer with the same shape.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 64, bounded at 320 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 20% by completion. Take the scored population from `request_latency.successful.count` rather than by subtracting the warmup count.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, one prefix bucket (bucket_weight 100, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 1600). Prompt exactly 400 tokens and output exactly 500, so every request is 1600 shared + 400 unique tokens. `request_format: plain`, so prefix and prompt are concatenated raw with no chat template (~2001-2002 tokens reach the engine). Greedy sampling (temperature 0.0), and the backend forces `ignore_eos`, so the bound emits exactly 160000 output tokens.
purpose: A single-GPU 8B assistant with a draft head, serving 64 concurrent users short prompts sharing one long preamble.
launch:
# Engine command line for commit 462ef83d58e6fadeb6e216dc583554a6980a0af9
# (`git describe --tags` -> v0.22.1rc0-459-g462ef83d58e6f). Interpreter and hardware: env.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# KEEP THIS ON ONE LINE. Written as a block mapping, the four children AND the parent key are
# lost, and the engine then starts with no speculative decoding, at rc=0, with nothing in the
# log to say so. Strict JSON reads identically as a YAML flow mapping, so it is the safe form.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "RedHatAI/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-speculator.eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 2, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1}

block-size: 1536
enable-prefix-caching: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 3072
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
